page.layout: Running head at top with page number right; below it a heading line with title and roman numeral at right; then a woodcut illustration in a framed box; below the picture a large initial verse of four lines of text in one block. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Equus fessore excusso currens. X.
main_text.p: Qvalis eques rapido nemorosa per auia cursu Corruit, effreni præcipitatus equo: Corpore tu, quēcunque Deus, Vel mente, beauit, Talis es, ipsius te nisi frœna regant.

page.notes: Woodcut illustration of a horse rearing and throwing its rider, with a man on the ground in the lower left, in a landscape with trees, hills and a tower. The large initial Q is decorative. The verse line "beauit" and "Vel" are printed as shown; "Deus,Vel" is spaced as printed.
